query: My TechCorp X1 Ultra screen flashes extremely quickly (in milliseconds) whenever I plug in a charger, making the display unusable for a short period.
query_variations: When the charger is attached, the X1 Ultra's display flickers at millisecond intervals, making it temporarily unreadable.
Connecting a power adapter causes the X1 Ultra screen to flash rapidly, resulting in a brief period of unusable display.
Plugging in the charger makes my X1 Ultra screen blink super fast and I can't see anything.
Whenever I hook up the charger, the X1 Ultra screen just flashes crazy fast and goes blank for a sec.
screen flicker charger X1 Ultra milliseconds
Why does the charger make my X1 Ultra screen flash like a strobe? It's useless!
Every time I plug the charger in, the X1 Ultra screen blinks insanely fast and I can't use it!

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Screen Flashing Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Screen flashing

actions.description: It will help identify damage or corrosion

steps: Inspect your phone or tablet, charger, and USB cable for any physical damage or signs of liquid exposure.
Remove any cases or accessories that might be covering the charging port or buttons.
Examine the USB connections for any corrosion or bent pins.
Check the Liquid Damage Indicator (LDI).
Turn off your phone or tablet.

actions.description: It will reset device and stop flashing

steps: If there's no physical or liquid damage, force a restart on your device.
Press and hold both the Power button (or Side button) and the Volume down button simultaneously for at least 20 seconds.
If your device has a removable battery, remove the battery for 60 seconds.
Reinsert it.
